product.name: Tankless Water Heater
product.description: A water heating system that provides instant hot water on demand without a storage tank, saving space and offering continuous hot water supply.

product.name: Heat Pump Water Heater
product.description: An energy-efficient water heater that transfers heat from surrounding air to heat water, using less electricity than traditional electric water heaters.

product.name: Gas Tank Water Heater
product.description: A traditional water heater that stores and continuously heats water in a tank using gas as the energy source.

product.name: Electric Tank Water Heater
product.description: A conventional water heater that stores hot water in a tank and uses electric power to maintain water temperature.

product.name: Water Heater Upgrade Quotes Service
product.description: An online service that provides homeowners with multiple guaranteed, fixed-price quotes for water heater upgrades after submitting project details and photos.

identifier.value: Virtual Site Visits for Home Upgrades

product.name: Virtual Site Visits for Home Upgrades
product.description: A remote evaluation service where contractors assess home upgrade projects using photos and data submitted online to provide guaranteed quotes.
